summary:
This bill says Congress does not approve a rule from the Securities and Exchange Commission, or SEC. The SEC is a government agency that oversees parts of the money and investing system.

The rule is called “Staff Accounting Bulletin No. 121.” It was published on April 11, 2022. The bill also mentions that the Government Accountability Office, or GAO, said on October 31, 2023, that this bulletin counts as a rule under a law about how Congress can review agency rules.

If this bill becomes law, the SEC rule called “Staff Accounting Bulletin No. 121” would have no force or effect. That means it would not count as a rule that must be followed.

The House of Representatives passed this resolution on May 8, 2024. The Senate received it on May 9, 2024.
